meta.name: Dallas Cowboys Cheer
meta.description:
Each season, hundreds will audition but only the best-of-the-best have what it takes to earn a spot on this elite team. See who has what it takes to wear the stars on CMT’s Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team.

Shows: Game Day, Episode 708, Episode 709, Episode 710, Episode 711 Finale
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
